thought.text: Login works with JWT issued. Let me verify QGIS through forward_auth and check the app assets.

reasoning_content:
Login works, JWT issued. Let me verify QGIS with authentication now, and check the tileserver missing mbtiles. Let me try QGIS forward_auth.

Let me test the app's /map route and resources. Let me also test an authenticated API call.

action.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
echo "=== qgis-auth endpoint ==="
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/qgis-auth/
echo "=== app /map page ==="
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://app.localhost/map
echo "=== frontend container log ==="
cd /workspace/deployment && docker logs qonnectra_frontend_dev 2>&1 | tail -10
